messages.subject: HMM examples all working with simulated data
parts:
I fixed all the HMM examples so they're working.
You can browse them here:

https://github.com/stan-dev/stan/tree/master/src/models/misc/hmm

The directory includes an R program to simulate data.

Sorry about not having checked the last ones --- they
shouldn't have been pushed to master before being checked.

I wrote four or five pages of descriptions of the models
in the latest manual, which you can always grab from the
buildbot:

http://d1m1s1b1.stat.columbia.edu:8080/job/Stan%20Manual/ws/doc/

The models all involve multinomial outputs. They implement
supervised estimation with various optimizations,
semisupervised estimation using the forward algorithm,
and prediction using the Viterbi algorithm.

Don't get too excited --- you're not going to be training
your next speech recognition models with Stan. Sampling is still
slow compared to optimization with something like EM.

- Bob
